test_title: PYST 37: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight boys Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Ram is the immediate neighbour of both Ramu and Anil. Sanjay is third to the right of Ramu. Ramu is second to the right of Anil. Ram is second to the left of Kamal. Vivek is not the immediate neighbour of Anil. Aakash is second to the right of Ramu. Who is second to the right of Vivek?
solution:
Eight boys **Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu** are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1. Sanjay is third to the right of Ramu. 

2. Ramu is second to the right of Anil.

3. Ram is the immediate neighbour of both Ramu and Anil.

4. Vivek is not the immediate neighbour of Anil. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd94b72492a1cc6b7ec0636daf8ab88bfc7eb55f62896fd6ca24941a58915537.png] 

5. Aakash is second to the right of Ramu.

6. Ram is second to the left of Kamal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64695fe13019f20f3410c37bbba95e3e2a4b82720f047c3c9ef2e3dea89f1a54.png] 

Vivek will occupy the position immediate to the right of Sanjay, as it is the only possible position Vivek can occupy.

And, Rahul is sitting between Anil and Vivek.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bee4db205ca0c44983943d0e18ab5741c3a70da13b19b7f0b617d6ab4f127704.png] 

Clearly, Anil is second to the right of Vivek.

Hence, '**Anil**' is the correct answer.
